---
title: "Session 9 · Positron and AI-assisted coding"
subtitle: "Use GitHub Copilot without giving up statistical judgment"
---

## Learning goals

Navigate an R project in Positron, configure the course-supported GitHub Copilot
provider, accept or reject a small completion, verify the statistical meaning of
suggested code, and disclose AI assistance.

## Before class

1. Install [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/download) using the official
   installer.
2. Open an existing BIOS6301 R project and confirm that an R console starts.
3. Confirm that you can sign in to the GitHub account associated with Copilot.

Do not uninstall RStudio. Positron is introduced as an additional environment,
not as a required permanent replacement.
